properties.name: batch
properties.label: Account batch
properties.description: Which import/run this account came in with, e.g. 'Reactivation US batch 1/6'. Set by the pipeline from the input sheet; used to filter and group briefs by batch.

properties.name: brief_json
properties.label: Brief guidance (JSON)
properties.description: Structured guidance the Cadence Agent card renders instead of prose paragraphs. Shape: {why_now{headline,points[]}, coordinate{owner,last_contacted,days_ago,deals,note}, corrections[], copy_rationale{hook,proof,persona,vertical}}. Optional and per-section — the card falls back to the why_now / first_touch_rationale prose properties for briefs written before this existed.

properties.name: signals_json
properties.label: Signals (JSON)
properties.description: JSON array, one entry per Tier-1 signal checked: {signal,present,strength,recency_days,confidence,hook_detail,note|evidence} — the shape score_accounts.py consumes. present:false entries record what was checked and why nothing counted (honesty trail). Rendered by the app card; the card also accepts the legacy {type,title,detail,date,source_url} shape.

properties.name: contacts_json
properties.label: Contact → flow map (JSON)
properties.description: All CRM contacts on the company, segmented by title → persona and grouped under the exact Gong US Flow to run each group in. {generated,total_contacts,mapped,groups:[{flow,persona,suite,contacts:[{id,name,title,email}]}],unmapped:[...]} — written by scripts/map_contacts.py, rendered by the app card.

properties.name: first_touch_rationale
properties.label: Why this copy
properties.description: Which signal (hook_detail) / benefit / proof the draft used.

properties.name: first_touch_basis
properties.label: First touch basis
properties.description: What the opener was built on. Set by the pipeline from score_accounts.py's needs_conjunctural flag + scripts/conjunctural_match.py — see knowledge/conjunctural/README.md.

properties.name: conjunctural_signal
properties.label: Conjunctural signal used
properties.description: Register id + label of the macro signal the copy used, e.g. 'mw-ca-2027-01: CA fast-food wage step'. Empty unless first_touch_basis = conjunctural.

properties.name: cadence_template
properties.label: Gong US Flow
properties.description: Exact flow name, e.g. 'FSR × Finance (IM · Tier 1)' — see cadences/UKI_FLOWS.md

properties.name: rep_feedback_detail
properties.label: Rep feedback — detail
properties.description: Free-text reason a rep marked a draft 'Needs work'. Written by the card's detail box on 👎 (via the record_feedback app function) — the highest-value input to the learning loop, since it says WHY, not just that it was wrong.

properties.name: variant_copied
properties.label: Variant copied
properties.description: Which first-touch variant the rep copied — preference data for the learning loop.

properties.name: reactivation_json
properties.label: Reactivation analysis (JSON)
properties.description: Structured reactivation analysis — the SOURCE OF TRUTH the Reactivation card renders. Shape: {verdict, verdict_reason, lead_with{name,title,why}, hook, ask, do_not_repeat[], why_it_died{headline,detail}, cycles[{label,dates,amount,picklist,reason}], evidence{calls,substantive_calls,emails,last_contact,current_tools[]}, flags[]}. Kept structured (not prose) so the card renders scannable components instead of walls of text — same pattern as signals_json/contacts_json. Length discipline is enforced by directives/reactivation_deal_analysis.md.

properties.name: reactivation_evidence_basis
properties.label: Reactivation evidence basis
properties.description: What evidence this analysis actually rests on — set honestly so a rep can calibrate confidence, never inflated. See scripts/reactivation_bundle.py + the reactivation-analysis runbook.

properties.name: reactivation_deal_history
properties.label: Reactivation — deal history
properties.description: Every closed/lost (or otherwise dead) deal found on this company: name, stage, amount, close date, and the closed-lost reason if the pipeline captured one. Written by the reactivation-analysis agent from scripts/reactivation_bundle.py's output — never fabricated; says 'no reason on file' when the deal has none.

properties.name: reactivation_call_analysis
properties.label: Reactivation — call analysis
properties.description: What the real Gong call transcripts for this account actually show: objections raised, who the champion/blocker was, pricing/budget reactions, why momentum stalled — each point traceable to a specific call. Empty or 'no calls found' when confirm_and_enrich() found nothing; never invented.

properties.name: reactivation_email_analysis
properties.label: Reactivation — email analysis
properties.description: Summary of logged HubSpot email engagement (opens/replies/bounces) associated with this account's past outreach, when available. Frequently empty — many teams send via a sequence tool that never logs to HubSpot; that is reported as a gap, not treated as 'no engagement'.

properties.name: reactivation_recommendation
properties.label: Reactivation — recommended first touch
properties.description: THE working field. One specific, evidence-grounded recommendation for the re-engagement FIRST TOUCH only — what changed since the deal died, what NOT to repeat, the precise angle to open with. Not general sales advice. Grounded strictly in reactivation_deal_history/call_analysis/email_analysis; must say plainly when there isn't enough evidence to recommend anything specific.

properties.name: reactivation_last_deal_url
properties.label: Reactivation — deal link
properties.description: Direct HubSpot URL to the most recent closed/lost deal on this company, for the rep to open in one click.

properties.name: reactivation_analysis_date
properties.label: Reactivation — analysis date
properties.description: When scripts/reactivation_bundle.py + the analysis agent last ran for this account.
